_note: uv sync --extra aigamestore: the vendored aigamestore-gym env (gym/aigamestore), which needs a Chromium browser (system Chrome by default). Lock-stepped: fps must equal 60 / frame_skip (10 with the default frame_skip 6).
_levels_note: No levels (an endless runner): each episode is one run, and ends when it is lost. The block plays one episode and ends with it (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1): one run, however long it lasts, with max_duration 300 s as the safety cap rather than the block length. No pass_score: an endless runner has no level to clear, and its score (distance plus coins) is the measure. The running score is shown over the frame and the final score at the end.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary over the game's keys, in aigamestore_gym.GAME_KEYS order -- game4: 0=SPACE, 1=UP -- so 'keys' values are those indices (the JSON key is what the subject presses) and held keys combine. The env relabels the on-canvas hints to the pressed key; keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
